description: The worker should join completion stubs to source object embedding rows by embedding id so vectors are generated from the planned text rather than empty placeholders.
The local runtime should produce deterministic fixed-dimension vectors without network calls, provider credentials, or model downloads.
Completed embedding rows and stored vector rows should pass vector readiness with no missing vectors, text hash mismatches, dimension mismatches, or orphan rows.
Hashing-vector output should be marked with its runtime and model so product search can evaluate quality before tenant-visible semantic ranking uses it.
